text.body: paratattvalīnamanase praṇamadbhavabandhamocanāyāśu | prakaṭitaparatattvāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 1 || paramaśivendrakarāmbujasambhūtāya praṇamravaradāya | padadhūtapaṅkajāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 2 || vijananadīkuñjagṛhe mañjulapulinaikamañjutaratalpe | śayanaṃ kurvāṇāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 3 || kāmāhidvijapataye śamadamamukhadivyaratnavāridhaye | śamanāya mohavitateḥ praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 4 || namadātmabodhadāyāramate paramātmatattvasaudhāgre | samabuddhaye'śmahemnoḥ praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 5 || gilitāvidyāhālāhalahatapuryaṣṭakāya bodhena | mohāndhakāraravaye praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 6 || śamamukhaṣaṭkamumukṣāvivekavairāgyadānaniratāya | tarasā natajanatataye praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 7 || siddhāntakalpavallīmukhakṛtīkartre kapālibhaktikṛte | karatalamuktiphalāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 8 || tṛṇapaṅkaliptavapuṣe tṛṇato'pyadharaṃ jagadvilokayute | vanamadhyaviharaṇāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 9 || nigṛhītahṛdayaharaye pragṛhītātmasvarūparatnāya | praṇatābdhipūrṇaśaśine praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 10 || ajñānatimiraravaye prajñānāmbhodhipūrṇacandrāya | praṇatāghavipinaśucaye praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 11 || matimalamocanadakṣapratyagbrahmaikyadānaniratāya | smṛtimātratuṣṭamanase praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 12 || nijaguruparamaśivendraślāghitavijñānakāṣṭhāya | nijatattvaniścalahṛde praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 13 || pravilāpya jagadaśeṣaṃ pariśiṣṭākhaṇḍavastuniratāya | āsyaprāptānnabhuje praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 14 || upadhānīkṛtabāhuḥ parirabdhaviraktirāmo yaḥ | vasanīkṛtakhāyāsmai praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 15 || sakalāgamāntasāraprakaṭanadakṣāya namrapakṣāya | saccitsukharūpāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 16 || drākṣāśikṣaṇacaturavyāhārāya prabhūtakaruṇālaya | vīkṣāpāvitajagate praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 17 || yo'nutpannavikāro bāhau mlecchena chinnapatite'pi | aviditamamatāyāsmai praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 18 || nyapatansumāni mūrdhani yenoccariteṣu nāmasūgrasya | tasmai siddhavarāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 19 || yaḥ pāpino'pi lokāṃstarasā puṇyaniṣṭhāgryān | karuṇāmburāśaye'smai praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 20 || siddheśvarāya buddheḥ śuddhipradapādapadmanamanāya | baddhaughamocakāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 21 || hṛdyāya lokavitateḥ padyāvalidāya janmamūkebhyaḥ | praṇatebhyaḥ padayugale praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 22 || jihvopastharatānapyāhvoccāreṇa jātu naijasya | kurvāṇāya viraktān praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 23 || kamanīyakāmānākartre śamanīyabhayāpahāracaturāya | tapanīyasadṛśavapuṣe praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 24 || tārakavidyādātre tārāpatigarvavārakāsyāya | tārajapapravaṇāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 25 || mūko'pi yatkṛpā cellokottarakīrtirāśu jāyeta | adbhutacaritāyāsmai praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 26 || durjanadūrāyatarāṃ sajjanasulabhāya pātrahastāya | tarutalaniketanāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 27 || bhavasindhutārayitre bhavabhaktāya praṇamravaśyāya | bhavabandhavirahitāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 28 || trividhasyāpi tyāgaṃ vapuṣaḥ kartuṃ sthalatraye ya iva | akarotsamādhimasmai praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 29 || kāminapi jitahṛdayaṃ krūraṃ śāntaṃ jaḍaṃ sudhiyam | kurute yatkaruṇāsmai praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 30 || vedasmṛtisthavidvallakṣaṇalakṣyeṣu sandihānānām | niścayakṛte vihartre praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 31 || bālāruṇanibhavapuṣe līlānirdhūtakāmagarvāya | lolāya citi parasyāṃ praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 32 || śaraṇīkṛtāya suguṇaiścaraṇīkṛtaraktapaṅkajāya | dharaṇīsadṛkkṣamāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 33 || praṇatāya yativareṇyairgaṇanāthenāpyahāryavighnahṛte | guṇadāsīkṛtajagate praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 34 || sahamānāya sahasrāṇyaparādhān praṇamrajanaracitān | sahasyaiva mokṣadātre praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 35 || dhṛtadehāya natāvalitūrṇaprajñāpradānavāñchataḥ | śrīdakṣiṇavaktrāya praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 36 || tāpatrayārtahṛdayastāpatrayahāradakṣanamanamaham | guruvarabodhitamahimā praṇatiṃ kurmaḥ sadāśivendrāya || 37 || sadātmani vilīnahṛtsakalavedaśāstrārthavit sarittaṭavihārakṛtsakalalokahṛttāpahṛt | sadāśivapadāmbujapraṇatalokalabhye prabho sadāśivayateṭ sadā mayi kṛpāmapārāṃ kuru || 38 || purā yavanakartanasravadamandarakto'pi yaḥ punaḥ padasaroruhapraṇatamenamenonidhim | kṛpāparavaśaḥ padaṃ patanavarjitaṃ prāpayat sadāśivayatīṭ sa mayyanavadhiṃ kṛpāṃ siñcatu || 39 || hṛṣīkahṛtacetasi prahṛtadehake rogakairanekavṛjinālaye śamadamādigandhoijjhate | tavāṅghripatite yatau yatipate mahāyogirāṭ sadāśiva kṛpāṃ mayi prakuru hetuśūnyāṃ drutam || 40 || na cāhamaticāturīracitaśabdasaṅghaiḥ stutiṃ vidhātumapi ca kṣamo na ca japādike'pyasti me | balaṃ balavatāṃ vara prakuru hetuśūnyāṃ vibho sadāśiva kṛpāṃ mayi pravara yogināṃ satvaram || 41 || śabdārthavijñānayutā hi loke vasanti lokā bahavaḥ prakāmam | niṣṭhāyutā na śrutadṛṣṭapūrvā vinā bhavantaṃ yatirāja nūnam || 42 || stokārcanaprītahṛdambujāya pākābjacūḍāpararūpadhartre | śokāpahartre tarasā natānāṃ pākāya puṇyasya namo yatīśe || 43 || nāhaṃ hṛṣīkāṇi vijetumīśo nāhaṃ saparyābhajanādi kartum | nisargayā tvaṃ dayayaiva pāhi sadāśivemaṃ karuṇāpayodhe || 44 || kṛtayānayā natāvalikoṭigatenātimandabodhena | mudamehi nityatṛptapravara stutyā sadāśivāśvāśu || 45 || || iti śṛṅgagirijagadguru śrīśrī saccidānandaśivābhinavanṛsiṃhabhāratīmahāsvāmibhiḥ viracitaḥ śrīsadāśivendrastavaḥ ||
